nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): pure addition helper that returns c = a + b and requires c >= a.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): pure subtraction helper requiring b <= a before c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): pure multiplication helper verifying a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): pure division helper requiring b > 0 before c = a / b.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) restricted by onlyOwner: stores pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits event, moves owner and zeroes newOwner.
PureChainToken constructor: writes token metadata and mints the entire supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves balances[msg.sender] to 'to' using SafeMath and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and reduces allowance of msg.sender.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval.
Fallback function: payable and unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call to arbitrary token contract.
Owned.owner: address with privileged rights, initialised from msg.sender.
Owned.newOwner: pending ownership transfer target.
PureChainToken.symbol: token ticker string, 'PCT'.
PureChainToken.name: human readable token name.
PureChainToken.decimals: 18.
PureChainToken._totalSupply: total minted token amount.
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances per account.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance ownership and allowance ownership.
Arithmetic c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).

External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied contract.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) in the onlyOwner modifier.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == newOwner) in acceptOwnership.
